title: Draft native LabVIEW job recipes and staged output records for the 23 native-required development slots (design only, no execution)
body:
## Goal
The 11 public development cases carry 23 native-required slots that no static reading can fill (benchmark/cases/dev/README.md table). Capability #169 (bounded native jobs on the NI container path) is waiting for the owner. Protocol `## oracle` and resources-proposal Row 2 say the public part can be done now: job recipes with declared input hashes, permitted operations, required LabVIEW versions and staged output schemas. Expected gain: when #169 becomes ready, native evidence for every native-required slot can be dispatched without further design, and the job contract is reviewable now. The next Policymaker checks `python3 -I benchmark/scripts/native_jobs.py --check` exit 0 and the report's slot-to-recipe count (23 of 23 mapped, or each unmapped slot named with its reason).
## Acceptance
- [ ] Turn 1: write `.session/report.md` (status wip). Update it after each file you write.
- [ ] New directory `benchmark/native/` with `README.md`, `recipes.json` and `output-record.template.json`, generated by new stdlib script `benchmark/scripts/native_jobs.py` (writes them; `--check` regenerates in memory and fails on any byte difference, unknown slot id, missing input sha256, or an operation outside the permitted list).
- [ ] Each recipe: id, covered slot ids, input artifact path + sha256 (from benchmark/sources.json or coverage.json), required LabVIEW version/bitness/modules (unknown -> null with reason), permitted operations (read properties, diagram capture, controlled I/O; no edits, builds or network), expected staged outputs with sha256 fields, and the independent-check procedure. Include one recipe matching the #169 readiness check (one public VI with independently known behaviour), and say which VI and why.
- [ ] README states plainly: design only, nothing executed, no native evidence exists, #169 not ready, native 2024 and other versions unproven; no readiness or quality claim.
- [ ] Do not edit benchmark/preparation.json, preparation-status.json, protocol.md, resources-proposal.md, cases or challenges. Do not run `git commit` (the parent commits).
## Verification
`python3 -I benchmark/scripts/native_jobs.py --check`
## Context
- benchmark/cases/dev/README.md: slot counts per family.
- benchmark/protocol.md `## oracle` (search 'native job recipes'): required recipe content.
- benchmark/resources-proposal.md `## Row 2`: permitted operations, readiness check.
- benchmark/baseline/ and benchmark/scripts/baseline.py: pattern for a template + --check generator.
## Budget
- Find native-required slots with one bounded `python3 -I` script that prints only slot ids, case ids and artifact paths; never print or Read whole case JSON (up to 445k characters) or benchmark/results/challenges.json. Verification must not need LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT or git. Report the remaining unmapped slots instead of exploring further.
